embedservice-description: This forked version adds a parser function for embedding videos from popular sources.
embedservice-refreshmetadata-invalid-tar: This tool only works for local audio and video files handled by EmbedService.
embedservice-error-missingparams: EmbedService is missing a required parameter.
embedservice-error-service: EmbedService does not recognize the video service "$1".
embedservice-error-id: EmbedService received the bad id "$2" for the service "$1".
embedservice-error-width: EmbedService received the bad width parameter "$1".
embedservice-error-height: EmbedService received the bad height parameter "$1".
embedservice-error-alignment: EmbedService was given an illegal value for the alignment parameter "$1". Valid values are "left", "center", or "right".
embedservice-error-valignment: EmbedService was given an illegal value for the valignment parameter "$1". Valid values are "top", "middle", "bottom", or "baseline".
embedservice-error-urlargs: EmbedService received a list of URL arguments that contained malformed data or blank arguments.
embedservice-error-unknown: EmbedService encountered an unknown error while trying to generate this video embed block. ($1)
embedservice-error-evp_deprecated: The #evp parser function was deprecated in EmbedService 2.0. Please convert your parser function tag to #ev.
embedservice-error-container: The parameter provided for 'container' is invalid.
embedservice-error-url-not-whitelisted: The provided url is not set in $wgAllowExternalImagesFrom
apihelp-embedservice-summary: Get generated video embed code for given parameters.
apihelp-embedservice-param-service: Name of the service (youtube, twitch, etc)
apihelp-embedservice-param-id: The ID of the video for that service
apihelp-embedservice-param-dimensions: Either a numeric width (100) or width by height (100x100)
apihelp-embedservice-param-urlargs: Additional arguments to pass in the video url (for some services)
